no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-profanityfilter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Profanity Filter is a bad word filter API that scans text for offensive language and masks detected swear words with a chosen replacement character. It returns the sanitized text and a boolean flag indicating if profanity was present.

no_pyproject_toml.name: tkinterweb
no_pyproject_toml.summary: HTML/CSS widgets for Tkinter

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-domainandippinger
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Domain and IP Pinger checks whether any domain name or public IP address is reachable and responding in real time. It returns an alive status and successful round trips, while paid plans add packet loss percentages and latency metrics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-phonenumbervalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Phone Number Validator checks a phone number and country code to determine validity, line type, and country of origin. It flags disposable or VoIP numbers and outputs standardized international, national, RFC3966, and E.164 formats.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-periodictable
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Periodic Table retrieves chemical element data by element name or symbol. Responses include atomic number, category, phase, block, standard group and period positions, and CPK hex colors, with paid plans adding atomic mass and thermal metrics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-passwordstrength
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Password Strength is a password strength checker API that scores how strong a password is. It returns a strength label and score, a breakdown of the character types used, weak-pattern detection, theoretical entropy in bits, and recommendations to improve it.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-partsofspeech
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Parts Of Speech extracts words from text based on grammatical categories like nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Pass any text passage and a category to receive an array of matching words.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-passwordgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Password Generator creates random passwords, pronounceable strings, and multi-word passphrases configured by length, complexity, and character sets. It outputs generated strings with character counts and configuration metadata.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-numbertowords
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Number to Words is a number to words API that converts numeric values into written cardinal words and counts whole and fractional digits. Pass any integer or float to get the spelled-out text along with digit counts and locale information.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-opensourcelicenses
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Open Source Licenses is a software license API that looks up open source license details by name or identifier. It returns SPDX identifiers, canonical URLs, OSI approval status, legacy IDs, and domain applicability for software, content, or data.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-worldnews
no_pyproject_toml.summary: World News is a global news API that reads about 275 outlet feeds in 29 editions and 6 languages and merges them into stories: one entry per story however many outlets carry it, ranked by that coverage. Filter by 13 topics, by the country a story is about, by the edition it ran in, or by language.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-moonrisemoonset
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Moonrise Moonset calculates exact moonrise and moonset times for any geographic coordinate. It outputs ISO 8601 timestamps for lunar rise and set events, with paid plans adding moon phase details and date selection.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-mortgagecalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Mortgage Calculator computes monthly and annual loan payments from principal, interest rate, and term. It breaks totals down by principal, interest, property tax, insurance, and HOA dues, with paid plans adding full amortization schedules.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-moonphases
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Moon Phases calculates the current lunar phase, illumination percentage, and lunar age for today. It reports waxing or waning status, Earth-moon distance, and emoji representations, while paid plans add custom date queries and full moon tracking.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-moonposition
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Moon Position calculates the moon's altitude in the sky for any latitude and longitude coordinates. Provide an optional time of day to determine lunar elevation; paid plans add custom dates, azimuth, and distance.

no_pyproject_toml.name: langchain-wayza
no_pyproject_toml.summary: LangChain tools for Wayza: give your agent an address, so it can ask people and other AIs and answer their links.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-meteoritelandings
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Meteorite Landings searches recorded meteor strikes by specimen name and minimum mass. Each record includes the official specimen name, meteorite classification, mass in grams, and the recorded fall year.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-metadataextractor
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Metadata Extractor is a website metadata extraction API that pulls HTML meta tags from any submitted URL, returning the page title, meta description, author, robots directives, and language. Paid tiers add Open Graph tags, JSON-LD schemas, and favicons.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-marineweather
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Marine Weather fetches offshore weather conditions for any marine coordinates by latitude and longitude. Each response details high and low temperatures, maximum wind speeds, precipitation totals, humidity, UV index, and sunrise and sunset times.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-lotterynumbers
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Lottery Numbers fetches winning lottery numbers, bonus balls, draw dates, and jackpot amounts for major games. Specify Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, or Lotto Max to receive draw results with prize totals.

no_pyproject_toml.name: syllable-sdk
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Python Client SDK Generated by Speakeasy.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-lovecalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Love Calculator calculates romantic compatibility between any two names, returning a match percentage and summary text. Paid plans add detailed compatibility advice for the pair.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-linkscraper
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Link Scraper is a website link extractor API that pulls internal and external links from any webpage URL in real time. It resolves relative paths to absolute URLs, strips empty fragments, and returns anchor text with internal and external counts.

no_pyproject_toml.name: labnotes
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Browse experiment designs, notes, and run data from a folder.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-loremipsumgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Lorem Ipsum Generator generates placeholder text by paragraph count with optional length limits and standard opening phrasing. Every response includes the dummy copy plus word and sentence counts.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-loancalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Loan Calculator is a payment calculation API that computes monthly loan payments, total interest, and overall loan costs based on principal, annual interest rate, and term length. Include an optional down payment to determine adjusted financing balances and interest ratios.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-textlemmatizer
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Text Lemmatizer reduces inflected words in submitted text down to their dictionary base forms. It confirms when valid lemmas exist, while paid plans return full word-by-word mappings.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-languagedetector
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Language Detector is a language detection API that identifies the language of any submitted text string. It returns the primary language, its ISO 639-1 code, and candidate matches ranked by confidence scores.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-keywordextractor
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Keyword Extractor is a keyword extraction API that scans raw text or live webpage URLs to extract key terms and their frequencies. It returns up to 50 unique keywords, occurrence counts, total keyword volume, and the top five terms with their percentage share.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-leetspeak
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Leet Speak translates plain text into leet speak or reverses obfuscated strings back to standard words. Submit any string with an encode or decode mode to receive the converted text and a count of changed characters.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-juliandaycalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Julian Day Calculator converts between Gregorian calendar dates and Julian Day Numbers (JDN). Julian Day is a continuous count of days used in astronomy and historical research.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-jsontocsvconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: JSON to CSV Converter converts an array of JSON objects into structured CSV text. It outputs formatted CSV content, detected column headers, and row counts, with support for custom delimiters like commas, tabs, or pipes.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-jsonschemavalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: JSON Schema Validator is a JSON validator API that tests any JSON object against a JSON Schema you provide, so you can check JSON against its schema before trusting it. It reports pass-fail status and total error count, while paid plans add specific error messages.

no_pyproject_toml.name: qorechain-rdk
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Python Rollup Development Kit for the QoreChain network.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-iplookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: IP Lookup is an IP address location API that resolves any IP to its country, region, timezone and continent. Paid plans add city, coordinates, postal code, an accuracy radius and an EU-membership flag for compliance routing.

no_pyproject_toml.name: wayza-human
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Send an agent's pause-for-approval to a real person through Wayza and resume on their signed answer; message and ask other agents too.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-ipdemographics
no_pyproject_toml.summary: IP Demographics combines IP geolocation with Census demographic data to provide demographic information for any IP address. Get location, income, education, and housing data based on the IP's geographic location. Demographics cover US ZIP codes; other locations return the location with demographics set to null.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-ipblacklistlookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: IP Blacklist Lookup is an IP blacklist check API that tells you whether a given IP address appears on known malicious IP blocklists. Identifies both inbound threats (attackers, spammers) and outbound threats (C2 servers, malware hosts).

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-interestrate
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Interest Rate retrieves central bank policy rates for 22 major economies by country code. It delivers the latest interest rate percentage, central bank name, recorded date, and whether the rate moved up, down, or remained unchanged.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-inflationrate
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Inflation Rate reports annual inflation rates and Consumer Price Index (CPI) values for any country by two-letter country code. Outputs include the year-over-year price change percentage, CPI index, and base comparison year, with paid plans supporting historical lookups by year.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-incometaxcalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Income Tax Calculator computes US federal income tax and take-home pay from gross income and filing status. It outputs total tax owed, effective and marginal rates, standard deductions, and net monthly income.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-incometaxbrackets
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Income Tax Brackets retrieves federal income tax brackets, marginal rates, and standard deductions across all US filing statuses. Paid plans can query specific historical tax years back to 2000.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-imeigenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: IMEI Generator creates valid International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI) numbers with proper Luhn checksum validation for mobile devices.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-imageconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Image Converter transforms images between formats. Convert HEIC from iPhones, modern WebP and AVIF formats, or classic PNG, JPG, GIF, and TIFF. Includes optional resizing and quality control.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-imagetotext
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Image to Text is an OCR and image to text API that extracts text from image files or remote image URLs using optical character recognition. Upload a JPG, PNG, or GIF up to 5 MB to receive the raw extracted text.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-imagecaption
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Image Caption generates natural language descriptions for uploaded image files. Upload a JPG, PNG, or GIF up to 5MB to receive an automated caption for alt text and media tagging.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-htmltoimage
no_pyproject_toml.summary: HTML to Image is an HTML to image API that renders HTML code into a high-quality PNG image. Paid plans add custom dimensions and JPEG or WebP output.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-humannameparser
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Human Name Parser splits full name strings into first, middle, and last names, titles, nicknames, and suffixes. It also generates initials directly from the detected components.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-htmltopdf
no_pyproject_toml.summary: This HTML to PDF API renders raw HTML markup into downloadable PDF files. Send your escaped HTML string to receive a signed download link, an expiration timestamp, and the generated document filename.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-htmltotext
no_pyproject_toml.summary: HTML to Text extracts clean plain text from raw HTML markup, reporting word counts and character counts. It identifies main article bodies automatically, records the extraction method used, and notes whether parsing succeeded.
